name: Azeroth Companion
title: Sovereign Gear & Talent Mastery
features: Added read-only source-backed side-by-side equipped-item comparisons in Live Armory, showing Blizzard-returned equipment names, slots, IDs and item levels.
Compare recorded B-minus-A item-level differences when available, with clear warnings that cross-slot differences and higher item levels do not establish upgrades or combat effectiveness.
Inspect either item directly using the existing official Item Codex without typing its ID again.
Review a separately labeled Talent Forge draft summary of manually allocated Class, Specialization and Hero points, without asserting that it is a character's in-game build.
No new API requests, data migrations, extra account permissions or saved-build changes; further live testing will follow when players are available.
